adjudication.rationale: In packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts, both updateEvent and deleteEvent now derive the calendar ID like `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy/undefined, the `find` predicate compares each `cal.externalId` to `undefined`, so it will not match any real calendar and returns `undefined`. That makes the computed calendarId undefined (or forces a fallback like "primary" if used later), so deletions/updates can target the wrong calendar or fail to delete the originally-created event—consistent with orphaned events.
